SELECT	 
	'@{variables('Home_Ref')}' AS HOME_REF,
	Site.SiteId AS siteid,
	Site.SiteName as sitename, 
	RESIDENT.RES_CODE as resident_no,
	InvPosting.account_No, 
	InvPosting.Cre_DateT AS created_date, 
	InvPosting.Inv_Date AS transaction_date,
	CASE 
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'U' THEN 'Receipt'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'I' THEN 'Invoice'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'C' THEN 'Credit'
		WHEN InvPosting.Tran_Type = 'J' THEN 'Adjustment'
		ELSE ''
	END AS transaction_type,
	InvPosting.Ref1 AS transaction_ref1, 
	InvPosting.Ref2 AS transaction_ref2, 
	InvPosting.Value AS transaction_value, 
	InvPosting.Balance AS transaction_balance, 
	Memo,
	USERCOMM AS UserComment
FROM		 
	InvPosting (NOLOCK) 
	
	JOIN Site (NOLOCK) 
		ON Site.Site_Ref = InvPosting.Site_Ref

	LEFT JOIN RESIDENT (NOLOCK)
		ON RESIDENT.RES_REF = INVPOSTING.RES_REF
WHERE	
	InvPosting.Site_Ref  = '@{variables('SITE_REF')}'
SELECT HOME_REF, HomeName, SITE_REF FROM ColdHarbourHomeID WHERE HOME_REF = '@{variables('Home_Ref')}'

source.sqlReaderQuery:
DECLARE @Today AS DATE = GETDATE()
DECLARE @PreviousYear AS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(YEAR,-2,@Today)), MONTH(@Today), 1)

SELECT 
	HomeID, 
    IntranetID,
	Homename, 
	ExchCode,
    CompanyPeriods.ExchequerYear,
    CompanyPeriods.PeriodYear,
    CompanyPeriods.PeriodNo,
    CompanyPeriods.CalendarFullDescription
FROM 
	Avery.HomeDetails

    INNER JOIN Exchequer.CompanyPeriods
        ON CompanyPeriods.ExchCompanyCode = HomeDetails.ExchCode
        AND CompanyPeriods.PeriodReportDate = @PreviousYear
WHERE
	ExchCode IS NOT NULL
	AND ExchCode != 'KETT01' --Doesnt exist in Exchequer
ORDER BY
	HomeId ASC

activities.name: Lookup Years and PartionIDs
activities.description: Calculate the Current and Previous Fin Years and the partitions for them

source.sqlReaderQuery:
DECLARE @Today AS DATE = GETDATE()
DECLARE @CurrentPeriod AS DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@Today), MONTH(@Today), 1)
DECLARE @T AS udf.INT_List

INSERT INTO @T
SELECT DISTINCT
    ExchequerYear AS CurrentYear
FROM 
    Exchequer.CompanyPeriods 
WHERE 
    PeriodReportDate = @CurrentPeriod
ORDER BY
    ExchequerYear DESC

SELECT 
    ExchequerYear,
    $PARTITION.pf_FinancialTransactions_ExchequerYear(ExchequerYear) AS PartitionID
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        INT_Value - 1 AS ExchequerYear
    FROM @T
    UNION
    SELECT 
        INT_Value
    FROM @T
) AS x

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
    HD.HomeID
	,HD.IntranetID
	,HD.HomeName
    ,Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    ,P.ExchequerYear
    ,P.PeriodYear
    ,P.PeriodNo
    ,YEAR(P.PeriodReportDate)                       AS CalendarYear
    ,MONTH(P.PeriodReportDate)                      AS CalendarMonth
    ,P.CalendarMonthLongName
    ,P.CalendarFullDescription
    ,P.PeriodReportDate
    ,P.QuarterNo

    ,Lines.tlFolioNum                               AS FolioNum
    ,Lines.tlRunNo                                  AS RunNo
    ,Lines.tlDocType                                AS DocType
    ,CASE
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 0 THEN 'Sales Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 1 THEN 'Sales Receipt'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 2 THEN 'Sales Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 3 THEN 'Sales Journal Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 4 THEN 'Sales Journal Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 15 THEN 'Purchase Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 16 THEN 'Purchase Payment'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 17 THEN 'Purchase Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 18 THEN 'Purchase Journal Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 19 THEN 'Purchase Journal Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 20 THEN 'Purchase Refund'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 21 THEN 'Purchase Payment with Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 22 THEN 'Purchase Quotation'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 30 THEN 'Nominal Transfer'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 31 THEN 'Control Record'
        ELSE ''
    END                                             AS DocTypeName
    ,Lines.tlGLCode                                 AS GLCode
    ,ISNULL(N.GLName, '')                           AS GLName
    
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Lines.tlLineDate)            AS LineDate
    ,Lines.tlRecStatus                              AS RecStatus
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Lines.tlReconciliationDate)  AS ReconciliationDate
    ,Lines.tlOurRef                                 AS ExchequerRef

    ,thYourRef AS YourRef
	,CASE WHEN Lines.tlDocType != 30 
        THEN thLongYourRefTrans ELSE '' END         AS AltRef
    ,CASE WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 30 
        THEN thLongYourRefTrans ELSE '' END         AS JournalDesc
    ,Header.thCustSupp                              AS CustSupp

    ,Lines.tlAcCode                                 AS AcCode
    ,ISNULL(CS.acCompany, '')                       AS AccountName
    ,Lines.tlDescription                            AS LineDescription
    ,Lines.tlQty                                    AS Qty
    ,Lines.tlQtyMul                                 AS QtyMul
    ,Lines.tlNetValue                               AS LineNetValue
    ,Lines.tlDiscount                               AS LineDiscount
    ,Lines.tlCurrency                               AS Currency
    ,0.00 /*Lines.tlPreviousBalance */                   AS PreviousBalance
    ,Lines.tlLineType                               AS LineType
    ,Lines.tlLineNo                                 AS TransLineNo
    ,Lines.tlVATCode                                AS LineVATCode
    ,Lines.tlVATAmount                              AS LineVATAmount
    ,Lines.tlPaymentCode                            AS PaymentCode
    ,Lines.tlItemNo                                 AS ItemNo
    ,Lines.tlJobCode                                AS JobCOde

    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thCreationDate)       AS CreationDate
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thTransDate)          AS TransactionDate
	,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thDueDate)            AS DueDate
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thPostedDate)         AS PostedDate

    ,Header.thNetValue                              AS DocumentNetValue
    ,Header.thTotalVAT                              AS DocumentTotalVAT
    ,Header.thAmountSettled                         AS DocumentAmountSettled
    ,Header.thAuthorisedAmnt                        AS DocumentAuthorisedAmnt
    ,Header.thTotalLineDiscount                     AS DocumentTotalLineDiscount
    ,Header.thSettleDiscAmount                      AS DocumentSettleDiscAmount
    ,Header.thTotalOrdered                          AS DocumentTotalOrdered
    ,Header.thTotalOrderOS                          AS DocumentTotalOrderOS
    ,Header.thRemitNo                               AS DocumentRemitNo

	,Header.thOriginator                            AS Originator
    ,ISNULL(Originator.UserName, '')                AS OriginatorUserName
	,Header.thOperator                              AS Operator
    ,ISNULL(Operator.UserName, '')                  AS OperatorUserName
    
    ,Lines.PositionId                               AS LinePositionId
	,Header.PositionId                              AS DocumentPositionId

    ,'FolioNum'                                     AS HeaderJoinMethod
FROM
    Exchequer_Bronze.Details AS Lines

    INNER JOIN Avery.HomeDetails AS HD
        ON HD.ExchCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    INNER JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.Document AS Header 
        ON Header.thFolioNum = Lines.tlFolioNum
        AND Header.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.CustSupp AS CS
        ON CS.acCode = Lines.tlAcCode
        AND CS.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer.CompanyPeriods AS P
        ON P.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode
        AND P.ExchequerYear = Lines.tlYear
        AND P.PeriodNo = Lines.tlPeriod

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer.NominalCodes AS N
        ON N.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode
        AND N.glCode = Lines.tlGLCode

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.MlocStk AS Originator
        ON Originator.ExchCompanyCode = Header.ExchCompanyCode
        AND Originator.varCode1Trans1 = Header.thOriginator

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.MlocStk AS Operator
        ON Operator.ExchCompanyCode = Header.ExchCompanyCode
        AND Operator.varCode1Trans1 = Header.thOperator
WHERE
    Lines.tlYear IN (@{variables('ExchequerYearsString')})

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    HD.HomeID
	,HD.IntranetID
	,HD.HomeName
    ,Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    ,P.ExchequerYear
    ,P.PeriodYear
    ,P.PeriodNo
    ,YEAR(P.PeriodReportDate)                       AS CalendarYear
    ,MONTH(P.PeriodReportDate)                      AS CalendarMonth
    ,P.CalendarMonthLongName
    ,P.CalendarFullDescription
    ,P.PeriodReportDate
    ,P.QuarterNo

    ,Lines.tlFolioNum                               AS FolioNum
    ,Lines.tlRunNo                                  AS RunNo
    ,Lines.tlDocType                                AS DocType
    ,CASE
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 0 THEN 'Sales Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 1 THEN 'Sales Receipt'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 2 THEN 'Sales Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 3 THEN 'Sales Journal Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 4 THEN 'Sales Journal Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 15 THEN 'Purchase Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 16 THEN 'Purchase Payment'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 17 THEN 'Purchase Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 18 THEN 'Purchase Journal Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 19 THEN 'Purchase Journal Credit Note'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 20 THEN 'Purchase Refund'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 21 THEN 'Purchase Payment with Invoice'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 22 THEN 'Purchase Quotation'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 30 THEN 'Nominal Transfer'
        WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 31 THEN 'Control Record'
        ELSE ''
    END                                             AS DocTypeName
    ,Lines.tlGLCode                                 AS GLCode
    ,ISNULL(N.GLName, '')                           AS GLName
    
    ,'1900-01-01' /*TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Lines.tlLineDate)*/           AS LineDate
    ,Lines.tlRecStatus                              AS RecStatus
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Lines.tlReconciliationDate)  AS ReconciliationDate
    ,Lines.tlOurRef                                 AS ExchequerRef

    ,thYourRef AS YourRef
	,CASE WHEN Lines.tlDocType != 30 
        THEN thLongYourRefTrans ELSE '' END         AS AltRef
    ,CASE WHEN Lines.tlDocType = 30 
        THEN thLongYourRefTrans ELSE '' END         AS JournalDesc
    ,Header.thCustSupp                              AS CustSupp

    ,Lines.tlAcCode                                 AS AcCode
    ,ISNULL(CS.acCompany, '')                       AS AccountName
    ,Lines.tlDescription                            AS LineDescription
    ,Lines.tlQty                                    AS Qty
    ,Lines.tlQtyMul                                 AS QtyMul
    ,Lines.tlNetValue                               AS LineNetValue
    ,Lines.tlDiscount                               AS LineDiscount
    ,Lines.tlCurrency                               AS Currency
    ,0.00 /*Lines.tlPreviousBalance */                    AS PreviousBalance
    ,Lines.tlLineType                               AS LineType
    ,Lines.tlLineNo                                 AS TransLineNo
    ,Lines.tlVATCode                                AS LineVATCode
    ,Lines.tlVATAmount                              AS LineVATAmount
    ,Lines.tlPaymentCode                            AS PaymentCode
    ,Lines.tlItemNo                                 AS ItemNo
    ,Lines.tlJobCode                                AS JobCOde

    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thCreationDate)       AS CreationDate
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thTransDate)          AS TransactionDate
	,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thDueDate)            AS DueDate
    ,TRY_CONVERT(DATE, Header.thPostedDate)         AS PostedDate

    ,Header.thNetValue                              AS DocumentNetValue
    ,Header.thTotalVAT                              AS DocumentTotalVAT
    ,Header.thAmountSettled                         AS DocumentAmountSettled
    ,Header.thAuthorisedAmnt                        AS DocumentAuthorisedAmnt
    ,Header.thTotalLineDiscount                     AS DocumentTotalLineDiscount
    ,Header.thSettleDiscAmount                      AS DocumentSettleDiscAmount
    ,Header.thTotalOrdered                          AS DocumentTotalOrdered
    ,Header.thTotalOrderOS                          AS DocumentTotalOrderOS
    ,Header.thRemitNo                               AS DocumentRemitNo

	,Header.thOriginator                            AS Originator
    ,ISNULL(Originator.UserName, '')                AS OriginatorUserName
	,Header.thOperator                              AS Operator
    ,ISNULL(Operator.UserName, '')                  AS OperatorUserName
    
    ,Lines.PositionId                               AS LinePositionId
	,Header.PositionId                              AS DocumentPositionId       

    ,'OurRef' AS HeaderJoinMethod            
FROM
    Exchequer_Bronze.Details AS Lines

    INNER JOIN Avery.HomeDetails AS HD
        ON HD.ExchCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    INNER JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.Document AS Header
        ON Header.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode
       AND Header.thOurRef = Lines.tlOurRef

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.CustSupp AS CS
        ON CS.acCode = Lines.tlAcCode
        AND CS.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer.CompanyPeriods AS P
        ON P.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode
        AND P.ExchequerYear = Lines.tlYear
        AND P.PeriodNo = Lines.tlPeriod

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer.NominalCodes AS N
        ON N.ExchCompanyCode = Lines.ExchCompanyCode
        AND N.glCode = Lines.tlGLCode

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.MlocStk AS Originator
        ON Originator.ExchCompanyCode = Header.ExchCompanyCode
        AND Originator.varCode1Trans1 = Header.thOriginator

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer_Bronze.MlocStk AS Operator
        ON Operator.ExchCompanyCode = Header.ExchCompanyCode
        AND Operator.varCode1Trans1 = Header.thOperator
WHERE
    Lines.tlYear IN (@{variables('ExchequerYearsString')})  
    AND Lines.tlGLCode > 0
    AND Lines.tlFolioNum = 0
    AND(
        Lines.tlCurrency != 0
        OR
		    (
		    Lines.tlCurrency = 0
		    AND Lines.tlGLCode = 83050
		    )
	    OR
		    (
		    Lines.tlCurrency = 0
		    AND Lines.tlGLCode = 83045
		    )
        )

        AND CompanyPeriods.ExchequerYear = STG_Details.tlYear
        AND CompanyPeriods.PeriodNo = STG_Details.tlPeriod

    LEFT JOIN Exchequer.GeneralLedgerCategory 
        ON GeneralLedgerCategory.GL_CODE = STG_Details.tlGLCode
ORDER BY
    [STG_Details].tlYear ASC,
    [STG_Details].tlPeriod ASC,
    [STG_Details].ExchCompanyCode ASC

activities.name: Set EndDateTime
activities.description:
Find the most recent Sunday and set the time to 23:59:59
Logic Below:
Get today's UTC date.
Calculate the day of the week (Sunday = 0, Monday = 1, ..., Saturday = 6).
Make that number negative.
Subtract that many days from today (this gives the most recent Sunday).
Set the time to 23:59:59 UTC.

activities.name: Set StartDateTime
activities.description:
Find the Monday six days before the most recent Sunday and set the time to 00:00:00.
Logic Below:
Get today's UTC date.
Calculate the day of the week.
Make that number negative.
Subtract that many days from today (this gives the most recent Sunday).
Subtract another 6 days (this gives the Monday before that Sunday).
Set the time to 00:00:00 UTC
